Connection-pool exhaustion triggered by.challenged_claim: Pool exhaustion caused by the flag-enabled facet aggregation is the failure mechanism and trigger of the outage.

counterclaims.statement: The pool maximum is inferred from active=20/20, not read from configuration, so the exhaustion threshold is assumed rather than confirmed.

evidence_gaps: No per-query connection-hold-time metric directly confirms the ~8x-longer hold from the facet path.
falsification_tests: Reproduce the faceted query in staging and measure connection-hold time and pool saturation versus the non-faceted path.

A no-backoff client retry storm amplifie.challenged_claim: A no-backoff retry storm amplified the pool exhaustion.

counterclaims.statement: The 3.1x retry rate is observed after saturation began, so retries may be a symptom of the queueing rather than an independent amplifier.

evidence_gaps: Retry origin (client SDK vs gateway) and whether backoff was configured are not captured.
falsification_tests: Attribute the retries to a client and confirm the absence of exponential backoff during the window.

Flash-sale traffic surge amplified but d.challenged_claim: The flash-sale traffic surge is an amplifying condition, not a standalone cause.

counterclaims.statement: A higher-traffic sale the prior week (3200 rps) ran with zero errors and pool_active peaking at 15/20, so traffic volume alone does not exhaust the pool.

evidence_gaps: The prior sale's query path and pool size are not confirmed identical, weakening the direct comparison.
falsification_tests: Confirm the 05-07 sale ran the non-faceted query path and the same pool size before treating it as a clean control.

The v4.7.1 deploy regressed search (reje.challenged_claim: The 14:00 deploy regressed search and caused the outage.

counterclaims.statement: The deploy shipped the facet code with the flag OFF, the flag was enabled two minutes later by a separate job, and a rollback did not stop the 503s.

evidence_gaps: No diff confirms whether any unflagged code in v4.7.1 touched the search path.
falsification_tests: Diff v4.7.1 for any unflagged change to the search query or pool configuration.

An Elasticsearch cluster or hardware fau.challenged_claim: An Elasticsearch cluster or hardware fault caused the slow queries and outage.

counterclaims.statement: The cluster stayed green with normal CPU and heap and no restarts or shard reallocations throughout the window.

evidence_gaps: Per-shard latency is not captured, so a single hot shard masked by a green status cannot be fully excluded.
falsification_tests: Inspect per-shard query latency for a hot shard that a green cluster status could hide.
